newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish mobile phone sales up 30 pct '96 - industry.
newsitem.headline: Swedish mobile phone sales up 30 pct '96 - industry.

text.p: Sales of mobile telephones in Sweden rose 30 percent in 1996 compared with a year ago, the industry group MobileTele Deliveries said.
In the year a total of 1,064,432 mobile phones were sold compared to 816,095 in 1995.
A breakdown of sales in 1996 found that 924,020 of the phones sold were GSM and 140,412 NMT telephones.
Sales in December 1996 however were slightly lower than a year ago at 94,207 compared with 94,392 in December 1995.
Of these, 89,056 were GSM and 5,151 were NMT telephones.
